4.9

Review Hex?

Reviewers say Hex makes data analysis feel more accessible, interactive, and easier to present, especially for exploratory work. Users highlight templates that helped them get from little knowledge to a working Python deployment, and they like being able to explore data, generate insights, and build visualizations without handling every technical step manually. A maker of Product Hunt also says it was useful for prototyping formula changes without touching production code. The main criticism is transparency: reviewers want clearer visibility into how agentic workflows and calculations are produced.

Review Product Hunt?

Reviewers largely see Product Hunt as a strong place to discover new tools, watch trends, and get fast feedback from a tech-focused community. Users repeatedly praise the discussions, reviews, and launch-day visibility, while several makers say it reaches early adopters better than smaller directories; for example, the maker of ZapDigits calls the developer experience great. But praise is not universal: some users report weak support, confusing search or UX issues, and one detailed review questions opaque vote weighting and missing comments during launches.

Review Luma AI?

Reviewers praise Luma AI for striking photorealism and coherent motion, with creators noting a learning curve that pays off in impressive results. Some users highlight convenient mobile capture and strong performance for photogrammetry/NeRF workflows. A minority voice raises serious concerns about opaque credit usage and support, urging caution. Maker feedback is notably enthusiastic: makers of Rubbrband commend Dream Machine’s high-quality video, makers of Vidify applaud the image-to-video engine, and makers of Genbler say it elevated visual depth and precision for their team.
